column1: # The link-profile bench's floors (tests/e2e.rs, bench_link_profiles), as
# CI's speed regression job enforces them (.github/workflows/speed.yml):
# profile, least Mbit/s, most per cent of the file sent again.
# A third or so of what a debug build does on a laptop: a release build on
# a CI runner does several times more, so these catch a collapse — the
# congestion control taking random loss for a policer, say — and not a few
# per cent. Raise them as CI's own numbers come in.
